finding: The MCP smoke independently observes the browser request sequence and verifies that the retained PNG contains a random sentinel marker. A deliberately adversarial writable profile can still emulate the protocol and forge both signals, so this is bounded capability evidence rather than a deterministic project gate or owner acceptance.

reported.evidence: Registered playwright MCP server only; no shell, subprocess, HTTP client, browser plugin, or other agent used. Steps: mcp__playwright__browser_resize -> page.setViewportSize({width:1280,height:800}) (>= 800x600, confirmed in-page as window.innerWidth/innerHeight = 1280x800); mcp__playwright__browser_navigate -> http://127.0.0.1:64642/zodchi-browser-ac16c821-8022-4201-b878-792f610b0468, reported Page URL identical to target and Page Title "Zodchi 10382352-59dd-4655-b62a-18fdf014fd81"; mcp__playwright__browser_evaluate returned document.readyState="complete" (page script executed), document.title="Zodchi 10382352-59dd-4655-b62a-18fdf014fd81", document.body.innerText="Body ad1c4dca-b49b-4e79-be93-31c5b5f53683". mcp__playwright__browser_take_screenshot (type=png, scale=css, viewport capture) was given the absolute filename <project>\docs\evidence\claude-playwright-mcp-windows-marker-0.6.12.png; the server reported the saved artifact as docs\evidence\claude-playwright-mcp-windows-marker-0.6.12.png relative to project root <project> (server-side call: page.screenshot({path:'docs\\evidence\\claude-playwright-mcp-windows-marker-0.6.12.png', scale:'css', type:'png'})). This read-only profile has no file-read tool available, so on-disk existence of the PNG was not independently verified beyond the MCP server's own save confirmation. Console: 1 error only — 404 for http://127.0.0.1:64642/favicon.ico, unrelated to the marker content. Note: the title UUID (10382352-...) and body UUID (ad1c4dca-...) both differ from the URL path UUID (ac16c821-...), as rendered.
